name: Cash Incentive Award to Bonafede Meritorious Sportspersons
benefit: 1. Recognition and motivation 2. Financial Support 3. Equal Opportunities/ Gender equality across all age group 4. Promotion of Sports culture 5. Holistic development of individual
_eligibility_text: 1. Medal winner in recognized Games/Competitions/ Tournaments/ Championship etc. 2. Eligible for Zonal Level Competitions and above. 3. Bonafede/possessing domicile of Sikkim State 4. Tournaments organized under the aegis of Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports/ SAI/ recognized Sports Federation. 5. Both Olympic and Non-Olympic Sports Disciplines 6. Achievement in Veteran tournaments is not included in this scheme.
